seams.description: Audit publish seam: handle_transfer -> bus.publish('audit', event) -> subscribers. Consistency risks: topic name drift, event key set/value drift against C1, and exception propagation at publish time (V1 bus propagates; isolation must stay in the handler).
Audit persistence seam: consume(event) -> Store 'audit' table with (ts, actor, action) dedup. Consistency risks: dedup key drift, record shape (row must equal the event fields), table name drift.

e2e_gates.scenario: happy path: subscribe make_audit_consumer(store) at AUDIT_TOPIC, call handle_transfer(store, bus, 'acct-a', 'acct-b', 10.0); assert the response {'ok': True}, exactly 1 transactions row, and exactly 1 audit row whose keys equal AUDIT_EVENT_FIELDS
failure: the audit subscriber raises RuntimeError on publish; assert handle_transfer returns {'ok': True}, no exception escapes, the transactions row is written, and 0 audit rows exist
failure: publish the same well-formed event twice on 'audit' (redelivery); assert exactly 1 audit row and the second consume returns {'ok': True, 'deduped': True}
negative: handle_transfer(store, bus, 'a', 'b', -1) with the consumer subscribed; assert {'ok': False, 'error': 'bad-amount'}, 0 events on the bus, 0 transactions rows, 0 audit rows

notes: final_acceptance is merged into T04 (small plan, single E2E file): T04 also runs the full unittest suite and records A1-A4 evidence in its checkpoint, per the V1 rule that merging is allowed when recorded. T03 is read-only: owns_fixes_for is empty by design — it diffs, it does not patch.
